instrument: tri clauses -- which on-die clauses survive synthesis as logic, and which fold to a constant
why_they_fold: T555 put live counters on the OPERANDS so no clause could be satisfied by a constant folded at synthesis. The COMPARISON folds too: a probe register nothing writes collapses to its INIT; two structurally identical instances with identical operands are MERGED, so comparing them is a tautology; and a clause whose operands are both constants is evaluated at compile time. A folded clause reads PASS in every build, including the failing ones.

what_it_reinterprets.reinterpretable: gft_sadd 1111, gft_train1 1111, gft_smul 1010, gft_dup 1101 -- their specs and wrappers are unchanged since the die reads
what_it_reinterprets.gft_sadd: published as 'PASS -- 4 of 4 clauses on the die'. Really 1 of 1 MEASURED clause passed; three were constants.
what_it_reinterprets.gft_smul: published as '2 of 4 fail'. Really 2 of 2 MEASURED clauses FAIL -- every clause that design actually evaluates on silicon is false.
what_it_reinterprets.NOT_reinterpretable: gft_signed_mac 0011 was read against the PRE-W978 spec, where c_zero was real and false. Today's guard makes it fold. tri clauses describes today's sources and cannot be applied backwards across a source change.

the_repair.attempted_first: (* keep *) on the probe register and the instances -- INSUFFICIENT. keep preserves the cell; opt still propagates the constant into the comparison.
the_repair.what_worked: the sources must be STRUCTURALLY DISTINCT and carry equal values: a second counter live2 with the same seed and step feeding the control instance, and a rotating probe register tested for a rotation-invariant property (!= 0).
the_repair.verified: tri clauses on the repaired wrapper: 4 clauses, 0 folded. LUT count rises 452 -> 696, which is itself the measure of how much logic the folding had been deleting.

first_honest_four_clause_reads.netlist: 696 LUT, 160 CARRY4 -- IDENTICAL in all three builds; only the placement differs
first_honest_four_clause_reads.the_finding: THE CONTROL FAILS. c_self compares two instances of the same function with the SAME operand order, fed by two counters that step identically -- and it is false at seeds 42 and 7. At seed 7 the control fails while the commutativity clause PASSES.
first_honest_four_clause_reads.consequence: the failure is not about operand order and never was. Two instances of one function disagree, whichever operands they get. Commutativity was the framing only because the identical-operand control had been folded to a constant and could not contradict it.
first_honest_four_clause_reads.cleaner_statement: one netlist, three placements, three different answers, with every clause now real -- which is what 'place-and-route is not function-preserving' should have meant all along, and it needs no commutativity argument.
